vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes land as their own ungrouped PR, immediately, targeting the lowest fixed version rather than latest (which may still be affected)

packageRules.description: Group only low-risk Go updates (patch + pseudo-version digests) into one PR; minors get their own PRs so one breaking bump cannot stall every other update

Regenerate files that embed dependency versions on branches that change Go modules: core-deps.golden (module graph) and the docgen outputs (docs.yaml + JSON Schema carry targetVersion/docsUrl of upstream config types). Writes are atomic and never leave an empty file.

commands: GOWORK=off go list -m all | awk '{print $1}' | LC_ALL=C sort > core-deps.golden.tmp && test -s core-deps.golden.tmp && mv core-deps.golden.tmp core-deps.golden
go generate ./cmd/docgen && go run ./cmd/docgen > docs.yaml.tmp && test -s docs.yaml.tmp && mv docs.yaml.tmp docs.yaml
go run ./cmd/docgen -format=schema > lakta.schema.json.tmp && test -s lakta.schema.json.tmp && mv lakta.schema.json.tmp lakta.schema.json && cp lakta.schema.json docs/public/lakta.schema.json
